# Metin Survivors

> Free-to-play 3D browser action roguelite (survivors-like) playable instantly with zero install on desktop and mobile browsers (WebGL2). Supports solo runs and real-time 1–4 player online co-op, cloud save sync, global leaderboards, and full Turkish (`tr`) + English (`en`) localization.

- Live URL: https://metin-survivors.com/
- Genre: 3D Action Roguelite / Survivors-like / Hack-and-Slash / Online Co-op
- Platform: Modern Web Browsers (WebGL2, Three.js — Desktop & Mobile, PWA-installable)
- Cost: Free-to-play, no download, no account required to start playing
- Languages: Turkish (Türkçe), English

## Key Content

- **5 Playable Hero Classes (10 Doctrines):**
  - Warrior / Savaşçı: Sinew (`Kuvvet`), Spirit (`Ruh`)
  - Ninja: Silent Edge (`Sessiz Bıçak`), Quiver (`Sadak`)
  - Yacha: Spellsteel (`Büyü Çeliği`), Hexcraft (`Lanet Sanatı`)
  - Shaman / Şaman: Talisman (`Tılsım`), Stormbalm (`Bora Merhemi`)
  - Wolfman: Redmane (`Kızıl Yele`), Moonmane (`Ay Yelesi`)
- **4 Zones:** Yeonmu Plains (`Yeonmu Ovası`), Suryeon Valley (`Suryeon Vadisi`), Mount Seori (`Seori Dağı`), Daeryeol (`Daeryeol`)
- **Scale:** 20 bosses, 114 skills, Metin stone corruption risk-reward events, manual aim + auto-combat modes
- **Multiplayer:** 1–4 player online co-op via shareable room codes with dedicated co-op leaderboards
- **Meta-Progression (Roguelite):** Talents, Armory, Blacksmith, Collection, and Codex persisted locally and via optional cloud save
